name: 在线课程服务
description: 课程、课时、报名与学习进度；报名时事务校验名额

routes.name: 注册
登录
课程列表
routes.script:
LET $rows = QUERY SELECT id, title, teacher, price, seats, enrolled FROM {{t:main}} WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC;
RETURN 200 { "rows": $rows.rows };

routes.name: 课程详情
新建课程
routes.script:
LET $ins = EXEC INSERT INTO {{t:main}} (title, teacher, price, seats) VALUES ({{body.title}}, {{body.teacher}}, {{body.price}}, {{body.seats}});
RETURN 201 { "ok": true, "id": $ins.insertId };

routes.name: 添加课时
routes.script:
EXEC INSERT INTO {{t:lesson}} (course_id, title, duration) VALUES ({{id}}, {{body.title}}, {{body.duration}});
RETURN 201 { "ok": true };

routes.name: 报名
我的课程
routes.script:
LET $rows = QUERY SELECT e.id, e.progress, c.title, c.teacher FROM {{t:main}} e JOIN {{t:course}} c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.user_only_id = {{user.onlyId}};
RETURN 200 { "rows": $rows.rows };

routes.name: 更新进度
routes.script:
EXEC UPDATE {{t:main}} SET progress = {{body.progress}} WHERE id = {{id}} AND user_only_id = {{user.onlyId}};
RETURN 200 { "ok": true };
